about_the_game:
A Song in Elyel Nalore is a 2D metroidvania with RPG elements.

Explore the vast wilderness of Elyel Nalore as you fight a wide variety of monsters and challenging bosses. Learn new skills and discover secret orbs to increase your chances of survival in this harsh world. Run, jump, and dodge your way past enemies and deadly obstacles. Do you have what it takes to survive, or will you die and be forgotten?

Features:

+Keyboard and Xbox Controller Support

+A Variety of Skills, Enemies, Bosses, and Secrets to Uncover

+Plaforming and Puzzles

+Pixel Art Environments and Characters

+Beautiful CGs

+Atmospheric Music

+A Good Story
